messages:
maria: Heads-up: DeepTech co-sell POC — they want a joint arch doc, SSO runbook, and pricing for a 2-week dedicated pool. Also legal flagged DPA/IP terms as blocker. They sent a security questionnaire. Anyone own SOC2 attestation + questionnaire answers?

 dan: I can draft the arch + infra runbook. Need their VPC CIDR/egress IPs and preferred region (us-west1?). Do we have a canned partner SSO flow? I have a template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/sso-template

 lee: Pricing quick note: ballpark for 4x-A100 equivalent reserved pool ~ $28k/mo. 2-week POC we can offer a limited dedicated trial (usage cap, no commit). If partner wants Hosted, it's pay-as-you-go. I'll put a tentative quote in the deck. Who's the billing contact?

 olivia: Looping legal — @rachel can you advise on DPA / IP. For the security questionnaire, please send the PDF to security@redwood.com. We have a SOC2 attestation pdf here: https://redwood-certs.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2-type2.pdf

 rachel: Need the questionnaire PDF + point of contact. Also we require: egress IP list, cert rotation cadence, KMS usage, and data residency reqs. If they ask for on-prem, plan 6–8 weeks for provisioning. For quick upload use:

 ```
 curl -X POST -F "file=@questionnaire.pdf" https://secure-uploads.redwood.com/upload -H "Authorization: Bearer <upload-token>"
 ```

 tom: I'll own the SSO runbook and demo steps. Dan, can you add a tenant-provision terraform snippet? I'll stitch it into the runbook.

 dan: Adding a small terraform snippet now and enabling prefix cache notes.

 ```
 resource "redwood_tenant" "deeptech" {
   name        = "deeptech-poc"
   region      = "us-west1"
   capacity    = "4xA100"
   sso {
     provider = "saml"
     metadata_url = "https://deeptech.example.com/saml/metadata"
   }
 }
 ```

 dan: Also recommend turning on KV prefix caching and batch size=32 for chat workloads to keep latency under 150ms.

 maria: Next steps: Dan/Tom — draft arch + SSO runbook by EOD Wed. Rachel/Olivia — confirm DPA path + security questionnaire asap. Lee — prep tentative pricing deck and entitlement list. I'll sync with partner Thurs 10am PT. :thumbsup:

 infra-bot: Created ticket #INC-4721 for partner trial provisioning (assignee: dan).

 lee: I'll DM finance about billing contact and entitlement flow. Thanks all :raised_hands:
